title: Critique: on a non-Cartesian view of the body the self is real

statements.text: Gallagher argues that whether there is a real self depends on the concept of reality used. On a non-Cartesian concept, an organism engaged in pragmatic action and interaction with others generates a self that is real and not an illusion. He also finds a slippage from metaphors, such as waking experience as an online hallucination, to claims of scientific fact.

sources.quote: the self should be considered something real, and not simply an illusion
one frequently finds a subtle slippage between metaphor and science
